decisions.reason: Because the garage door operator disappeared from the website already after its launch year, the early market signal appears weak and the option value of keeping it open is low relative to reallocating resources.

The glazed industrial sectional door remained visible beyond launch, fits the firm's core industrial door portfolio, and likely shares production and sales resources with existing systems, so keeping the option open is inexpensive.

The glazed insulated industrial sectional door stayed on the website after launch and matches customer demand for compliant, thermally efficient industrial solutions, making continued commercialization a reasonable low-risk extension of the core business.

This glazed industrial sectional door had dedicated website presence across multiple years, indicating stronger commitment and traction, so the firm should continue backing it as a core-adjacent growth option.
